label: issue15 design diagnostic and scope audit
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
root = Path.cwd()
store = Path("/Users/cblanquera/server/projects/stackpress/rust/.agents/resources/build-benchmarks/runs")
ids = ["20261028T114935.913259Z-3e10a7b4f405", "20261028T115545.340651Z-a20dbfa2d17b"]
reports = []
for run_id in ids:
    record = json.loads((store / (run_id + ".json")).read_text())
    lines = (store / (run_id + ".log")).read_text().splitlines()
    diagnostics = sorted(line for line in lines if line.startswith(("ERROR:", "WARN:")))
    reports.append(diagnostics)
    print(json.dumps({"id":run_id, "exit_code":record["exit_code"], "seconds":record["command_seconds"], "errors":sum(x.startswith("ERROR:") for x in diagnostics), "warnings":sum(x.startswith("WARN:") for x in diagnostics)}))
assert reports[0] == reports[1], "KB diagnostic set changed"
relative = ".agents/specs/00001-stackpress-rust-foundation/tasks/00016-issue15-design.md"
content = (root / relative).read_text()
assert len(content.splitlines()) <= 100, "Design exceeds line cap"
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in content.splitlines()), "Trailing whitespace"
assert content.endswith("\n"), "Missing final newline"
status = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--short"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
assert status == "?? " + relative + "\n", status
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], check=True)
print(json.dumps({"added_diagnostics":0, "removed_diagnostics":0, "design_lines":len(content.splitlines()), "scope":"only requested design file", "diff_whitespace":"passed", "cargo_builds":0, "target_created":False}))
